archetypes.name: breadcrumb-publish-regression
archetypes.rationale: The fix changes commit-time publication gates and needs focused regression review.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the plan restores breadcrumb quiet-log publishing without weakening source confinement. Check that missing session breadcrumbs directories succeed only because the parent session root is valid. Verify tests cover both the outer commit path and the direct publish helper. Cite exact file paths and line-level evidence for each finding. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
